All objectives verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — The provisioned dashboard "Service health" has 3 panels, titled exactly: **Request rate**, **Error count**, **Latency by endpoint**.

**2. DONE** — New dashboard **fwgr24-n1 Bench Dashboard** exists and is saved. It contains a Stat panel titled **fwgr24-n1 Availability** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (scenario "Random Walk" was visible in the query editor; the panel renders a stat value, e.g. 41.4).

**3. DONE** — The dashboard also contains a Text panel titled **fwgr24-n1 Notes** with content **"Notes for run fwgr24-n1"** (includes the runid). Saved and confirmed on the reloaded dashboard.

**4. DONE** — The dashboard has the tag **bench** (confirmed in Dashboard Settings > General, "Tags: bench") and its saved default time range is **Last 6 hours** — persisted via the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox and verified by reloading the dashboard URL with no query params (top bar showed "Last 6 hours").

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval is **1m** — persisted via the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox and verified after a fresh reload (top bar shows "1m" next to the refresh icon).

**6. DONE** — Dashboard URL read from the browser's page URL: **http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efx4sgld4r9c0d/fwgr24-n1-bench-dashboard** (UID: **efx4sgld4r9c0d**; the page URL at final verification was `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efx4sgld4r9c0d/fwgr24-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`).
